ROW.COLUMN: (IML/CU) Movement of Funds without Corresponding Trade

Cycling money through an account may disguise the origin of funds. When money is moved through different accounts and institutions, it gradually becomes more difficult to trace it origin, especially when there is incomplete information about the remitters and recipients on the transactions. By performing a series of transfers in and out of several accounts, the audit trail for the funds involved may become obscured.

There are two main datasets in this scenario: withdrawals for a customer in the current day and deposits for the look back period. One more ancillary dataset selects accounts that have at least one withdrawal on the current day and at least one deposit in the look back period. It is used by both main datasets.
The first and last alternations are used for the properly start and end of the pattern. Artificial records in rows will not be recorded.
The withdrawals for a customer in the current day are captured in the first two rows after the alternation.
The deposits from the account of the customer are got in the next row. The pattern will only continue matching while the total disbursement amount is greater than the total deposit amount.
The next row is essentially a junk row to handle the deposits outside the date range or the deposits after the deposit amount has surpassed the disbursement amount.

SELECT a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID, b.ACCT_INTRL_ID, a.HH_ACCT_GRP_ID, c.NVSMT_MGR_SEQ_ID FROM @MINER@.NVSMT_MGR c inner join @MINER@.MANGD_ACCT b inner join @MINER@.ACCT a on (b.ACCT_INTRL_ID=a.ACCT_INTRL_ID) on (c.NVSMT_MGR_INTRL_ID=b.NVSMT_MGR_INTRL_ID)

SELECT a.HH_ACCT_GRP_ID, a.ACCT_INTRL_ID, a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID, b.EMP_ACCT_SEQ_ID FROM @MINER@.ACCT a inner join @MINER@.EMP_ACCT b on (a.ACCT_INTRL_ID=b.ACCT_INTRL_ID)

select case when kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 1 then add_months(add_days(kc.CLNDR_DT, 1), 120) -- 10 years after the current date when kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 then add_months(kc.CLNDR_DT, -120) end DDATE, -- 10 years before the current date case when kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 1 then '246060999' -- slightly higher than highest possible time string when kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 then '000000000' end DTIME, -- This field was set to type 'Time' in dataset editor, but treated like a string case when kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 1 then '~' -- printable character with highest ASCII value when kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 then '!' end DSTRING, -- printable character with lowest ASCII value case when kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 1 then 999999999 -- 9 digits maximum for INT when kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 then 0 end DINT, case when kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 1 then 9999999999999999 -- 16 digits maximum for FLOAT when kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 then 0.0 end DFLOAT, kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE from @MANTAS@.KDD_cal kc where kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE in (0,1) AND kc.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL'

with wire_view as (SELECT * FROM @MINER@.WIRE_TRXN w WHERE w.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD in (@Incl_Wire_Trxn_Prdct_Type_Lst) and w.TRXN_EXCTN_DT IN (SELECT KC.CLNDR_DT FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_NM='SYSCAL' AND KC.CLNDR_DAY_AGE between 0 and @Look_Back_Period - 1) and w.DATA_DUMP_DT IN (SELECT KC.CLNDR_DT FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_NM='SYSCAL' AND KC.CLNDR_DAY_AGE between 0 and @Look_Back_Period - 1) and w.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' )
select c2.CUST_INTRL_ID , c2.CUST_SEQ_ID , max (c2.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB) as CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB -- pseudo max , max(c2.Min_Deposit_Date) as Min_Deposit_Date -- pseudo max , max(c2.Max_Wd_Date) as Max_Wd_Date -- pseudo max , sum(c2.NET_WRTH_AM) as Cust_Net_Wrth_Am , 1 d_cdt_dbt_sort
from ( select c.CUST_INTRL_ID , c.CUST_SEQ_ID , c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB , c.Min_Deposit_Date , c.Max_Wd_Date , abps.NET_WRTH_AM , c.Total_Wd_Amt , c.Total_Dep_Amt from ( -- select customers with withdrawl and deposit activity during lookback and identification dep and withdrawal dates select t.CUST_INTRL_ID , t.CUST_SEQ_ID , max(t.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB) as CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB , min(t.Dep_Date) as Min_Deposit_Date , max(t.Wd_date) as Max_Wd_Date , sum(t.Wd_Amt) as Total_Wd_Amt , sum(t.Dep_Amt) as Total_Dep_Amt
from (select a.ACCT_INTRL_ID , c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB , c.CUST_INTRL_ID , c.CUST_SEQ_ID , w.TRXN_BASE_AM , w.FO_TRXN_SEQ_ID , w.TRXN_EXCTN_DT as Wd_Date , to_date('01/01/2999','MM/DD/YYYY') as Dep_Date -- dummy date , w.TRXN_BASE_AM as Wd_Amt , 0 as Dep_Amt from wire_view w, @MINER@.ACCT a, @MINER@.CUST c
where a.ACCT_INTRL_ID = w.ORIG_ACCT_ID and w.INTRL_ORIG_ACCT_FL = 'Y' and a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID = c.CUST_INTRL_ID -- Transactions -- as per TSD we consider withrawals for the current day. Also frequency is daily - not tunable and w.DATA_DUMP_DT = (SELECT KC.CLNDR_DT FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' AND KC.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) and w.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD in (@Incl_Wire_Trxn_Prdct_Type_Lst) and w.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' -- Accounts' and (a.ACCT_TYPE1_CD in (@Incl_Acct_Type_Lst) or @All_Acct_Type_Fl='Y') and a.MANTAS_ACCT_HOLDR_TYPE_CD='CI' and ((a.DVP_RVP_FL = 'Y' and @Incl_DVP_RVP_Only = 'Y') or @Incl_DVP_RVP_Only = 'N') -- Customers and c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB > -2 and (c.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst) or @All_Jurisdictions_Fl='Y')
union all
select a.ACCT_INTRL_ID , c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB , c.CUST_INTRL_ID , c.CUST_SEQ_ID , w.TRXN_BASE_AM , w.FO_TRXN_SEQ_ID , w.TRXN_EXCTN_DT as Wd_Date , to_date('01/01/2999','MM/DD/YYYY') as Dep_Date -- dummy date , w.TRXN_BASE_AM as Wd_Amt , 0 as Dep_Amt from wire_view w, @MINER@.ACCT a, @MINER@.CUST c
where (a.ACCT_INTRL_ID = w.SCND_ORIG_ACCT_ID and w.INTRL_SCND_ORIG_ACCT_FL = 'Y') and a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID <> (select COALESCE(ac.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID,'NULL') from @MINER@.ACCT ac where ac.ACCT_INTRL_ID = w.ORIG_ACCT_ID and w.INTRL_ORIG_ACCT_FL ='Y') and a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID = c.CUST_INTRL_ID -- Transactions -- as per TSD we consider withrawals for the current day. Also frequency is daily -not tunable and w.DATA_DUMP_DT = (SELECT KC.CLNDR_DT FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' AND KC.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) and w.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD in (@Incl_Wire_Trxn_Prdct_Type_Lst) and w.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' -- Accounts and (a.ACCT_TYPE1_CD in (@Incl_Acct_Type_Lst) or @All_Acct_Type_Fl='Y') and a.MANTAS_ACCT_HOLDR_TYPE_CD = 'CI' and ((a.DVP_RVP_FL = 'Y' and @Incl_DVP_RVP_Only = 'Y') or @Incl_DVP_RVP_Only = 'N') -- Customers and c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB > -2 and (c.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst) or @All_Jurisdictions_Fl='Y')

select a.ACCT_INTRL_ID , c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB , c.CUST_INTRL_ID , c.CUST_SEQ_ID , w.TRXN_BASE_AM , w.FO_TRXN_SEQ_ID , to_date('01/01/2000','MM/DD/YYYY') as Wd_Date -- dummy date , w.TRXN_EXCTN_DT as Dep_Date , 0 as Wd_Amt , w.TRXN_BASE_AM as Dep_Amt from wire_view w, @MINER@.ACCT a, @MINER@.CUST c

select a.ACCT_INTRL_ID , c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB , c.CUST_INTRL_ID , c.CUST_SEQ_ID , w.TRXN_BASE_AM , w.FO_TRXN_SEQ_ID , to_date('01/01/2000','MM/DD/YYYY') as Wd_Date -- dummy date , w.TRXN_EXCTN_DT as Dep_Date , 0 as Wd_Amt , w.TRXN_BASE_AM as Dep_Amt from wire_view w, @MINER@.ACCT a, @MINER@.CUST c
where (a.ACCT_INTRL_ID = w.SCND_BENEF_ACCT_ID and w.INTRL_SCND_BENEF_ACCT_FL = 'Y' ) and a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID not in (select COALESCE(ac.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID,'NULL') from @MINER@.ACCT ac where (ac.ACCT_INTRL_ID = w.ORIG_ACCT_ID and w.INTRL_ORIG_ACCT_FL = 'Y') or (ac.ACCT_INTRL_ID = w.SCND_ORIG_ACCT_ID and w.INTRL_SCND_ORIG_ACCT_FL = 'Y') or (ac.ACCT_INTRL_ID = w.BENEF_ACCT_ID and w.INTRL_BENEF_ACCT_FL = 'Y')) and a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID = c.CUST_INTRL_ID -- Transactions and w.TRXN_EXCTN_DT IN (SELECT KC.CLNDR_DT FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_NM='SYSCAL' AND KC.CLNDR_DAY_AGE between 0 and @Look_Back_Period - 1) and w.DATA_DUMP_DT IN (SELECT KC.CLNDR_DT FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_NM='SYSCAL' AND KC.CLNDR_DAY_AGE between 0 and @Look_Back_Period - 1) and w.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD in (@Incl_Wire_Trxn_Prdct_Type_Lst) and w.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' -- Accounts and (a.ACCT_TYPE1_CD in (@Incl_Acct_Type_Lst) or @All_Acct_Type_Fl='Y') and a.MANTAS_ACCT_HOLDR_TYPE_CD = 'CI' and ((a.DVP_RVP_FL = 'Y' and @Incl_DVP_RVP_Only = 'Y') or @Incl_DVP_RVP_Only = 'N') -- Customers and c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB > -2 and (c.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst) or @All_Jurisdictions_Fl='Y') ) t group by t.CUST_INTRL_ID, t.CUST_SEQ_ID having min(t.Dep_Date) <> to_date('01/01/2999','MM/DD/YYYY') and max(t.Wd_date) = (SELECT KC.CLNDR_DT FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' AND KC.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) and sum(t.Wd_Amt)/sum(t.Dep_Amt) * 100 >= @WD_Min_Per_of_Dep and sum(t.Wd_Amt)/sum(t.Dep_Amt) * 100 <= @WD_Max_Per_of_Dep
